title: Signal: Dynamic SQL executed from text (plsql) — review required
scope: Single-line lexical match on dynamic SQL execution in plsql code.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: any dynamic execution form matches, including constant statements.

examples.line: EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ' || v_id;
# audit: EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ' || v_id; present
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = :1' USING v_id;
# verified: EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = :1' USING v_id;

fpNotes: A constant statement text assembled from fixed identifiers is the common false positive.
